question: Load the C. elegans metadata from 'distortions/notebooks/c_elegans/data/c_elegans_metadata.csv'. How many unique cell types are annotated in the 'cell.type' column?

Load the pre-generated distortion singular values from 'distortions/notebooks/pbmc/data/distortion_singular_values.csv' (2638 cells with lambda_1 and lambda_2 values per cell). What is the mean of the first singular value (lambda_1) across all cells? Report to 4 decimal places.

Load the C. elegans expression data from 'distortions/notebooks/c_elegans/data/c_elegans_data.csv' (86024 cells x 100 features) and metadata from 'distortions/notebooks/c_elegans/data/c_elegans_metadata.csv'. After sampling 100 cells per cell type from 8 cell types (Ciliated_amphid_neuron, Pharyngeal_neuron, GLR, Glia, Body_wall_muscle, Pharyngeal_muscle, Hypodermis, Intestine) with seed 42, generate UMAP embedding, compute local distortions using geometric Laplacian, and bind the metrics to the embedding. How many columns are in the resulting embedding dataframe with bound metrics?

Using the 3D mammoth point cloud data from 'distortions/notebooks/mammoth/data/mammoth_3d.csv' (10000 points with x, y, z coordinates), create an AnnData object, compute neighbors with 50 neighbors, run UMAP, then compute local distortions using the Geometry class with 'brute' adjacency method, 'geometric' laplacian method, radius set to 3 times the mean of the neighbor distances, and scaling_epps of 5. After computing the embedding and binding metrics, identify fragmented neighborhoods using threshold 0.1 and outlier_factor 3. How many fragmented neighborhoods are found?

Using the pre-generated PBMC3k AnnData object from 'distortions/notebooks/pbmc/data/data/pbmc3k_processed.h5ad' (2638 cells x 1838 genes, pre-processed), run UMAP embedding using 10 nearest neighbors with 50 PCA components and spectral initialization, then perform Leiden clustering with resolution 0.5, 2 iterations, igraph flavor, and undirected mode. How many unique clusters are identified?

Load the C. elegans expression data from 'distortions/notebooks/c_elegans/data/c_elegans_data.csv' (86024 cells x 100 features) and metadata from 'distortions/notebooks/c_elegans/data/c_elegans_metadata.csv'. Sample 100 cells from each of 8 specific cell types: Ciliated_amphid_neuron, Pharyngeal_neuron, GLR, Glia, Body_wall_muscle, Pharyngeal_muscle, Hypodermis, and Intestine using stratified sampling with seed 42. How many total cells are in the sampled subset?
